Education and development

Education can affect productivity, earnings, health, social mobility, and economic growth. Development research therefore studies both access to education and the quality of learning that students receive.

Important questions include how families make schooling decisions, how schools produce learning, and which policies improve educational outcomes. These questions often involve household constraints, teacher incentives, school resources, and institutional design.
